Method of Attack: Used five rooting exploits (CVE-2014-4321, CVE-2014-4324, CVE-2013-6282 (VROOT), CVE-2015-3636 (PingPongRoot), CVE-2014-3153 (Towelroot)) to root Android devices
Tapped into Zygote Android core OS process to replace referrer IDs and insert ads in legitimate apps
Could have been used to steal user data, install apps without consent, or show phishing pages
Impacted Systems: Android devices running Android 5 or earlier
Attack Vector: Infected apps installed from forums or third-party app stores
